The player in the background wears a blue jersey and black pants, skating towards the left. A small black hockey puck is visible on the ice near the feet of the player in red.

The object appears as a solid, opaque black disk without transparency or internal structures, matching the visual properties of vulcanized rubber.
The surface of the puck is black and non-reflective (matte), lacking the high-gloss specular highlights typical of plastic or metal, consistent with rubber.
